products.name: Obsidian AI
products.note: Local-first knowledge AI; plugins; privacy-focused; no cloud dependency

profile_text.body:
Obsidian is a for-profit startup founded in 2020 and headquartered in Los Angeles, CA, that makes a note-taking and knowledge management application of the same name. The company describes its product as "the free and flexible app for your private thoughts," emphasizing that notes are stored locally on the user's device, accessible offline, and readable by no one outside the user, including Obsidian itself. The application supports personal notes, journaling, knowledge bases, and project management, and allows users to create links between notes, visualize those relationships through an interactive graph, and work on an open-ended canvas feature the company calls "a limitless playground for your mind."

The site's tracked AI product, listed as Obsidian AI, is characterized as a local-first knowledge AI that operates through the app's plugin system without cloud dependency, consistent with the company's stated privacy focus. Obsidian also exposes an open API and describes a library of thousands of plugins that allow users to customize the application to their own workflows. No litigation, regulatory filings, or MCP server registrations appear in the held facts.
